rounds.text: SKP Securities Ltd is severely under-appreciated by the market, trading at an exceptionally low trailing price-to-earnings ratio of just 8.01x [E1]. This valuation looks even more disconnected when contrasted with the broader sector benchmark P/E of 20.12x, leaving this micro-cap with a market capitalisation of ₹ 78.0 Cr deeply discounted [E3, E6]. Crucially, this low multiple is paired with stellar, compounding profitability rather than distress, evidenced by a robust 18.6% return on equity and a compelling 21.7% return on capital employed [E12, E13]. The consistency of this earnings power is confirmed by a multi-year track record, showing a 10-year median ROE of 16% that accelerates to a 3-year median of 21% [E26, E28]. Investors are also paid to wait with a 1.75% dividend yield while the stock rests comfortably in the lower half of its 52-week range [E4, E5]. Conceded: [E8, E9].

Conceded: [E12]. Despite positive historical return metrics, the data provider reports a deeply concerning negative return on equity of -1.3% compared to a sector benchmark of 5.11% [E9]. Furthermore, the company's return on assets sits at a dismal -1.52%, severely underperforming the sector benchmark of 1.79% [E8]. These negative operational efficiency metrics directly conflict with backward-looking return claims and highlight underlying profitability risks that the headline P/E multiple of 8.01x masks [E1]. Investors relying solely on historical median returns risk buying into a deteriorating asset base where current profitability has turned negative [E9].

The bear relies on isolated data provider figures [E9, E8] while dismissing the company's own filed statements that confirm a strong ROCE of 21.7% [E12] and an ROE of 18.6% [E13]. The alleged operational deterioration is entirely contradicted by consistent multi-year performance showing a 10-year median ROE of 16% [E26], a 5-year median ROE of 19% [E27], and a 3-year median ROE of 21% [E28]. Far from a deteriorating asset base, filed statements demonstrate that the company's return metrics have actually expanded over time, reaching a 19% median return on equity last year [E29] backed by active screening signals [E66]. Conceded: data provider metrics report negative single-year figures [E9, E8], but these are heavily outweighed by the robust multi-year medians [E28] and current filed returns [E13]. Masked risks do not exist where fundamental earning power is sustained across multiple periods [E28] and offered at a compressed P/E of 7.22x against the sector benchmark of 20.12x [E6].

Conceded: filed statements report an ROCE of 21.7% [E12] and a current ROE of 18.6% [E13], alongside multi-year medians such as a 3-year ROE of 21% [E28] and a 10-year median ROE of 16% [E26]. However, the bull attempts to dismiss the data provider metrics entirely, yet those metrics reveal a severe structural disconnect showing a negative ROA of -1.52% versus a sector benchmark of 1.79% [E8] and a negative ROE of -1.3% against a sector benchmark of 5.11% [E9]. While the bull points to a compressed P/E of 7.22x against a sector benchmark of 20.12x [E6], this low multiple and the modest dividend yield of 1.75% [E4] reflect the underlying asset and return quality anomalies flagged by the data provider [E8, E9]. Furthermore, sitting at 59% of its 52-week range [E5] with a micro market capitalization of ₹ 78.0 Cr [E3], the valuation does not automatically signal a bargain when contrasting fundamental return reports carry such stark internal contradictions [E8, E9, E13].
